# isGridRangeSameDimensions

<link-summary>Checks whether two grid ranges have the same height and width.</link-summary>

<web-summary>isGridRangeSameDimensions() — Checks whether two grid ranges have the same height and width. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/sheet</code> · Since: 1.0.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function isGridRangeSameDimensions(range1: GridRange, range2: GridRange): boolean;
```

Where they sit does not matter, only how big they are — the question to ask before copying values from one range into another, since `setValues` rejects a mismatch.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type        | Description       |
| :-------- | :---------- | :---------------- |
| `range1`  | `GridRange` | The first range.  |
| `range2`  | `GridRange` | The second range. |

## Returns

`boolean` — `true` when both are the same size.

## Examples

### Comparing sizes

```javascript
const source = { startRowIndex: 0, endRowIndex: 2, startColumnIndex: 0, endColumnIndex: 2 };
const target = { startRowIndex: 5, endRowIndex: 7, startColumnIndex: 5, endColumnIndex: 7 };

isGridRangeSameDimensions(source, target); // => true
```
